tasks.title: Write hello.txt with HELLO FIXTURE content
tasks.spec: Create a file named hello.txt at the repository root. The file must contain exactly the text HELLO FIXTURE followed by a single newline character (i.e. 14 bytes: 'HELLO FIXTURE\n'). Use printf 'HELLO FIXTURE\n' > hello.txt or an equivalent shell heredoc. Do not add any extra lines, trailing spaces, or a BOM. After writing, confirm with: test -f hello.txt && grep -qxF 'HELLO FIXTURE' hello.txt && echo PASS || { echo FAIL; exit 1; }

tasks.title: Verify hello.txt end-to-end
tasks.spec: READ-ONLY: Final gate smoke test; validates the feature end-to-end without modifying any files. Procedure: 1) test -f hello.txt to confirm existence at the repo root. 2) test "$(cat hello.txt)" = "HELLO FIXTURE" to confirm exact content (single line, no extra whitespace). 3) Optionally check file size is 14 bytes via stat or wc -c. Print PASS if all checks succeed, FAIL otherwise. Do not create, delete, or modify any files.
